title: IronState Inventory
description: Remote hosts for 'ironstate --inventory'. Connection/elevation settings only: per-host configuration belongs in the playbook's hosts/ and variables/ overlays, which the agent selects from each target's own facts.

hosts.description: Hosts keyed by name. The name is a label; 'address' defaults to it, so an ~/.ssh/config Host alias works as-is.

groups.description: Named lists of hosts, selectable with --limit.

address.description: Hostname, IP, ssh config alias, or 'local' to run on the controller without SSH.

platform.description: Optional platform hint; use windows to select the PowerShell bootstrap for a Windows OpenSSH target.

agent_dir.description: Directory on the target for the cached agent (overrides --remote-agent-dir).

become.description: Whether to honor playbook become directives for this host. Set false to run those tasks as the SSH user without sudo/elevation.

verify_agent.description: Verify the target agent with a remote SHA-256 tool before execution. Set false only for trusted constrained targets without a SHA-256 utility; the agent is transferred over SSH and replaced on every run.
